confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors draw on several 2026 price snapshots for Utrecht, Amsterdam and national Dutch surveys, so they are moderately reliable. Beer is the least certain: most sources quote 500 ml, and the anchor is set lower to reflect a standard restaurant serving, which is an interpretive choice. The cocktail anchor rests on one undated Amsterdam spritz price and a beer-relative check. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and July seasonality; no booking pages or live listings were inspected. EUR to USD uses an assumed rate of about 1.12 USD per EUR, which was not sourced from RBA data. The FX value (0.6955 for 2026-10-15) comes from search-result snippets of the RBA exchange rates page, not from a full page read, and a later daily value may exist.
comparable_city_reasoning: Utrecht-specific cost-of-living and menu snapshots (Expat Arrivals, Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere), cross-checked against Amsterdam menu surveys and Dutch national beach-bar averages. Hostel and hotel tiers are estimated from comparable mid-sized Dutch cities with strong summer tourist demand. Cocktail price is tied to the local beer level, since direct cocktail data was thin.
